title: Separate historical W0 release snapshots from evolvable active source
current_behavior: The W0 ledger permanently hash-locks active source and the verifier itself, causing recursive CI failures after legitimate maintenance.
desired_behavior: Immutable evidence remains hash-verified while active source evolves under current tests and explicit semantic freezes.
non_goals: No market concept or trading rule change
No MQL5 consumer or call-site change
No workflow bypass or LFS disablement
No runtime, order or capital authority
